items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1968-11-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Now, what I can't understand, and Bill Russell asked me about this...

ctx.x: And Bill and Percy, they had a, they had a thing in Washington, a musical or a jazz festival, something like that. And me being 117 miles from Washington, my brother Willie sent me a telegram and said they'd be over there. And I went over there to see them, and after they explained the situation to me, I thought it would be anything else for me to do. But get things straight on that end and move on back in. Oh.
Well, now you've been away for 30 years. About 30 years. Yeah. How much change have there been in New Orleans in that 30 years?
